# 发动机适航与安全

_Engine Airworthiness & Safety_

中国民航局官方页面列出《航空发动机适航规定》CCAR-33-R2，并单独发布了附表 B3、B4 数据修正通知。这里保留官方入口，便于把规定正文、修正信息与验证资料对照阅读。

_The CAAC publication page lists CCAR-33-R2 and a separate correction notice for Tables B3 and B4. Official links support reading the regulation, corrections and validation evidence together._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 先核对辖区、适用对象、版本及修正文件。

_Check jurisdiction, applicability, revision and amendment documents first._

- 把条款要求、符合性方法和证据分别登记，不能用概述代替条款原文。

_Record requirements, compliance methods and evidence separately; an overview is not a substitute for the rule._

- 本页为学习索引；具体项目应以适用审定基础和主管机构要求为准。

_This is a study index; a specific project must use its applicable certification basis and authority requirements._
